name: symposium-ml
description: Remote ML training monitor for the Symposium rig — live loss curves, VRAM/GPU telemetry, rig logs, and one-key 'start a training run on the rig'.

commands.title: Symposium: Start Training Run on Rig

symposium.rig.url.markdownDescription: Base HTTP(S) URL of the Symposium training service (the `trainer/` FastAPI server, e.g. `uvicorn trainer.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765`). The extension derives the run endpoint (`POST <url>/runs`) and the live metric stream (`ws(s)://…/runs/latest/metrics`) from this. Point it at your gaming rig's LAN address to monitor training remotely.

symposium.rig.token.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on rig HTTP requests and WebSocket handshakes. Leave empty for an open LAN rig.

symposium.rig.autoConnect.markdownDescription: Automatically connect the **Symposium Rig** log channel to the rig's live run stream when the extension activates.

symposium.ai.local.url.markdownDescription: Primary local-model endpoint — the **Symposium host proxy** (OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/chat/completions`). Point at a LAN/cloud host to use a friend's or a rented GPU.

symposium.ai.local.fallbackUrl.markdownDescription: Fallback local-model endpoint — a raw **Ollama** server, used when the Symposium host proxy is unreachable.

symposium.ai.local.pairingCode.markdownDescription: 6-digit pairing code for the Symposium host proxy (sent as `x-symposium-code`). Leave blank for a raw/open Ollama endpoint.

symposium.ai.local.adminToken.markdownDescription: Admin token for the Symposium host proxy (sent as `x-symposium-admin` on management actions like pulling a model). Leave blank if you are a viewer on someone else's host.

symposium.ai.defaultProvider.markdownDescription: Which AI brain new panels select by default. **local** is free and offline; cloud providers only appear once you add a key via *Symposium: Add AI Model Key…*.

symposium.ai.cloudModel.anthropic.markdownDescription: Claude model id to use (blank ⇒ provider default). E.g. `claude-sonnet-4-6`.

symposium.ai.cloudModel.gemini.markdownDescription: Gemini model id to use (blank ⇒ provider default).

symposium.ai.cloudModel.openai.markdownDescription: OpenAI model id to use (blank ⇒ provider default).

symposium.collab.relayUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Symposium relay that fronts the Supabase-backed team roster, credits, and merge requests.
